title: Grand Bali Holiday with Safari and Kecak
alt: Ulun Danu Beratan temple at Bedugul, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani and the safari park
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small villa property on the quiet edge of Ubud

activities.name: Kintamani and rice terrace day tour
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

activities.name: Bali Safari and Marine Park
activities.description: Jungle Hopper entry with a safari ride through the African and Indian enclosures, the elephant and bird shows and the water park included.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Three nights inland with a coffee plantation day up to Kintamani and a full day at the safari park, good for families with children.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Bedugul and Uluwatu
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan at Bedugul, then the sea temple of Tanah Lot as the sun goes down.

activities.name: Water sports with the Kecak dance
activities.description: Banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa, Uluwatu temple in the late afternoon, then the Kecak fire dance in the cliff amphitheatre.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast, reached by way of the Bedugul lakes, with water sports at Tanjung Benoa, Uluwatu and a free beach day.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud villa and settle in
Rest of the day free in Bali's green interior
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
3: Breakfast, then a full day at Bali Safari and Marine Park
Safari ride through the African and Indian enclosures
Elephant and bird shows, then the water park
Back at the villa in the evening
4: Breakfast and check out, then north to the Handara gate
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
Check in at your Kuta hotel for three nights
5: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat and jet ski with an instructor
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs in the late afternoon
Kecak fire dance in the temple amphitheatre afterwards
6: Breakfast and a full day free on the coast
Optional: a surf lesson with an instructor on Kuta beach
Optional: Waterbom park, good for families
Optional: Kuta Square and the art market
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: The safari park and the water park make this one work for children. Parents get the temples in between.
expert.tip: Bali Safari needs a full day, so go early and carry swimwear for the water park. On the Bedugul day we leave Ubud by nine so you reach Tanah Lot comfortably before sunset.

summary: Seven days with three nights inland and three on the coast: Kintamani and the rice terraces, a full day at Bali Safari, the lake temples of Bedugul, sunset at Tanah Lot, water sports and the Kecak fire dance at Uluwatu.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and rice terrace tour; Bali Safari Jungle Hopper entry; Bedugul and Tanah Lot sunset tour; water sports with Uluwatu and the Kecak dance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
